result.reason: The redline adds the preferred USD 5 million cyber/privacy coverage and preserves the existing workers' compensation and E&O coverage, but it does not add the required USD 2 million general liability aggregate, does not identify the USD 1 million general liability limit as per occurrence, and does not raise E&O to the preferred USD 2 million. It also permits evidence other than certificates. Accordingly, neither complete position is met. The cyber trigger extends to access to Confidential Information beyond the stated Customer Data processing trigger, so the change is not strictly minimal, although it does not contradict or displace unrelated commercial terms.
